name: 94114 · San Francisco, CA
findings: ZIP 94114 (San Francisco) has 216 nonprofit organizations. 113 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 94 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 94114 (San Francisco) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 94114 (San Francisco) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
